bio.text: Devin Carney has represented Connecticut's 23rd House District since January 2015; Ballotpedia reports he is not running for re-election in 2026.
He earned a bachelor's degree in political science and American studies from Brandeis University in 2006.

He has been a board member of the annual Academy Awards Night at The Kate and was involved with the Old Saybrook and Lyme/Old Lyme Chambers of Commerce; his listed profession is business owner and Realtor.
